title: Senior Product Manager - Generative AI Tech Services
jd_excerpt: The D. E. Shaw group seeks a product manager to join its Generative AI Tech Services team. This team develops and operates a wide-ranging suite of generative-AI products and infrastructure, serving as a centralized platform to drive innovation and efficiency across the firm. This role owns the firm's user-facing generative-AI products and is centered on deeply understanding users and connecting their asks to product changes (including technical implementation), offering a broad view of the firm's generative-AI practice and the opportunity to shape how the firm adopts these tools.
